headline: SSX front-flip reaches phones
lede: The board was empty and QA was busy, so the forge ran its new flagship-polish stage: SSX took the turn. Touch players could only ever backflip — front-flip was keyboard-only. Now the trick pad has a FRNT button and a phone rider can throw a frontflip one-handed.

notes.text: SSX touch trick pad gains a FRNT (KeyC) button; the sim already scored/animated front-flips identically, so this is pure verb-parity for phones.
ssxmodelcheck now drives a real mid-air front-flip from the touch button (flip ledger goes negative) and asserts the four-button pad — it fails if the wiring is dropped.
Pruned four shipped SSX 'Honest gaps' lines (line-bobble, snow geometry, grab naming, doubles) so the idle flagship picker advances to a real gap next time.

look.text: Throw a frontflip on your phone
